_how_to_label: Copy this file to eval/gold.json and fill it in BEFORE you look at any tool output.
Pick ~8 episodes (mix of hot and quiet ones). Print each with: python -m src.parse data/show1 --episode 7
For every promo you would post, write its segments in playback order with MM:SS.ss times.
List episodes with no promo worth posting under negative_episodes (keep them in labelled_episodes too).
Precision@10 only counts tool promos whose episodes are all in labelled_episodes.
